blocks.en: □ Entering mid-semester course feedback [Portal mySNU → 기본정보 (Basic Information) → 수업/성적 (Classes/Grades) → 성적 (Grades) → 강의평가 (Course Evaluation)]

blocks.ko: - 조회할 교과목명을 클릭하여 중간 수강소감 조사 문항별 응답 내역 확인

english: The 「강의 중간 수강소감 조사」 (Mid-Semester Course Feedback Survey) for the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year has been extended as shown below. All students taking courses are encouraged to take part.
1. Survey period: 29 Oct 2026 (Thu) ~ 12 Nov 2026 (Thu) ※ Extended by 1 week
2. How to take part: Portal 마이스누 (mySNU) → 기본정보 (Basic Information) → 수업/성적 (Classes/Grades) → 성적 (Grades) → 강의평가 (Course Evaluation)
3. Courses included: All undergraduate and graduate courses (except the graduate course '논문연구' (Thesis Research))
4. Survey questions: 4 open-ended (free-answer) questions (answer the 2 questions about online classes only if they apply to your course)
○ Please write what was especially good or memorable about this course.
○ Please write anything in this course that could be improved.
○ Please write whether the online teaching methods (live video classes, recorded lecture videos, documents, assignments, etc.) suited the nature of this course.
○ Please write your overall satisfaction with the online classes and anything that could be improved.
